::: {.dynamic .horizontal header="🕹️ Simulation Interactive : Le Codebook (VQ-VAE)"}

::: {.controls header="Vecteur Continu (Sortie de l'Encodeur)"}
Déplacez les curseurs pour générer un vecteur d'information continu. Observez comment l'IA l'associe obligatoirement à un "concept type" de son dictionnaire.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// 1. Dictionnaire de vecteurs (Codebook) aléatoire mais fixe pour la session
codebookData = {
  const data = [];
  // On génère 16 vecteurs distribués aléatoirement
  for(let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    data.push({
      id: `Vect_${(i+1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
      x: 1 + Math.random() * 8,
      y: 1 + Math.random() * 8
    });
  }
  return data;
}

// 2. Paramètres de l'entrée continue
viewof vecX = ui.slider({label: "Axe X", value: 3.4, min: 0, max: 10, step: 0.1, state: 0})
viewof vecY = ui.slider({label: "Axe Y", value: 7.8, min: 0, max: 10, step: 0.1, state: 1})

```

:::

::: {.render .transparent header="Espace de Quantification (Le Dictionnaire)"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// 1. Initialisation de l'espace (Rendu persistant pour un drag fluide)
viewof vqSpace = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .attr("height", "100%")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 10 10`)
    .style("background", theme.base03)
    .style("border-radius", "12px")
    .style("box-shadow", "inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)");

  // Points du Codebook (Utilise codebookData)
  svg.selectAll("circle.codebook")
    .data(codebookData)
    .join("circle")
    .attr("class", "codebook")
    .attr("cx", d => d.x)
    .attr("cy", d => d.y)
    .attr("r", 0.28)
    .attr("fill", theme.base01)
    .style("transition", "fill 0.2s, stroke 0.2s");

  // Ligne de quantification
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("class", "quant-line")
    .attr("stroke", theme.red)
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", "0.2,0.1")
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.08)
    .attr("opacity", 0.8);

  // Point d'entrée (Interactif)
  const inputPoint = svg.append("circle")
    .attr("class", "input-point")
    .attr("cx", 3.4) // Initialisation explicite
    .attr("cy", 7.8)
    .attr("r", 0.45)
    .attr("fill", theme.blue)
    .attr("stroke", theme.base3)
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.08)
    .style("cursor", "grab")
    .style("filter", "drop-shadow(0 0 0.1 rgba(0,0,0,0.5))");

  // Logique de Dragging Bidirectionnel
  inputPoint.call(d3.drag()
    .on("start", function() { d3.select(this).style("cursor", "grabbing").attr("r", 0.55); })
    .on("drag", function(event) {
      const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, svg.node());
      const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, mx));
      const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, my));

      // Update des sliders OJS directement via leurs références viewof
      const elX = viewof vecX;
      const elY = viewof vecY;

      if (elX) {
        elX.querySelector('input').value = x;
        elX.value = x;
        elX.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
      }
      if (elY) {
        elY.querySelector('input').value = y;
        elY.value = y;
        elY.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
      }
    })
    .on("end", function() { d3.select(this).style("cursor", "grab").attr("r", 0.45); })
  );

  return svg.node();
}

// 2. Mise à jour réactive du SVG sans re-render
_update = {
  // Dépendances OJS
  vecX; vecY;

  const svg = d3.select(viewof vqSpace);
  const codebook = codebookData;

  // Calcul du voisin le plus proche
  let minDist = Infinity;
  let nearest = codebook[0];
  codebook.forEach(pt => {
    const d = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pt.x - vecX, 2) + Math.pow(pt.y - vecY, 2));
    if (d < minDist) { minDist = d; nearest = pt; }
  });

  // Update DOM direct pour la fluidité
  svg.select(".input-point")
    .attr("cx", vecX)
    .attr("cy", vecY)
    .style("filter", "drop-shadow(0 0 0.1 rgba(0,0,0,0.5))");

  svg.select(".quant-line")
    .attr("x1", vecX).attr("y1", vecY)
    .attr("x2", nearest.x).attr("y2", nearest.y);

  svg.selectAll("circle.codebook")
    .attr("fill", d => (d.id === nearest.id) ? theme.green : theme.base01)
    .attr("stroke", d => (d.id === nearest.id) ? theme.base3 : "none")
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.08);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // Génération du texte récapitulatif
  const codebook = codebookData;

  let minDist = Infinity;
  let nearestPoint = codebook[0];
  codebook.forEach(pt => {
    const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pt.x - vecX, 2) + Math.pow(pt.y - vecY, 2));
    if (dist < minDist) {
      minDist = dist;
      nearestPoint = pt;
    }
  });

  const term = ui.org.terminal({header: "VQ-VAE_Quantizer_Core.log"});
  const termBody = term.body;
  termBody.style.cssText = "font-family: var(--font-code); line-height: 1.4;";

  const step1 = document.createElement("div");
  step1.innerHTML = `<div style="color: ${theme.blue}; font-weight: bold;">> [ÉTAPE 1] INPUT_EMBEDDING_FLOAT</div>
    <div style="margin-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid ${theme.base01}; padding-left: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
      <span style="color: ${theme.base0};">Vecteur continu :</span> [ ${vecX.toFixed(3)}, ${vecY.toFixed(3)} ]<br/>
      <span style="color: ${theme.base01}; font-size: 0.85em;">Statut: Instable / Précision infinie</span>
    </div>`;

  const step2 = document.createElement("div");
  step2.innerHTML = `<div style="color: ${theme.yellow}; font-weight: bold;">> [ÉTAPE 2] NEAREST_NEIGHBOR_LOOKUP</div>
    <div style="margin-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid ${theme.base01}; padding-left: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
      <span style="color: ${theme.base0};">Distance Euclidienne :</span> ${minDist.toFixed(4)}<br/>
      <span style="color: ${theme.base01}; font-size: 0.85em;">Opération: Scan du Codebook (${codebook.length} vecteurs)</span>
    </div>`;

  const step3 = document.createElement("div");
  step3.style.cssText = `background: rgba(${theme.green_rgb}, 0.05); padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 3px solid ${theme.green};`;
  step3.innerHTML = `<div style="color: ${theme.green}; font-weight: bold;">> [ÉTAPE 3] QUANTIZED_CODE_INDEX</div>
    <div style="margin-left: 4px;">
      <span style="color: ${theme.base0};">ID Vecteur :</span> <span style="background: ${theme.green}; color: ${theme.base3}; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold;">${nearestPoint.id}</span><br/>
      <span style="color: ${theme.base0};">Position discrète :</span> [ ${nearestPoint.x.toFixed(1)}, ${nearestPoint.y.toFixed(1)} ]<br/>
      <span style="color: ${theme.green}; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.85em; margin-top: 4px;">[SUCCESS] Information compressée avec succès.</span>
    </div>`;

  termBody.appendChild(step1);
  termBody.appendChild(step2);
  termBody.appendChild(step3);

  return term;
}
```
